items.title: Indian Creek Drive (A1A) flood mitigation
items.summary: Indian Creek Drive, a state road, floods at high tide. The city and FDOT partnered to raise the road and its seawall, but the cost rose from $25.4 million to $30 million and a seawall built too close to the water delayed the work by about two years.

Seawall segment between 41 and 29 Streets: $4.3 million budget (City of Miami Beach project page)
